# WAMP Checkup, Round 2 (October 2026): item details

Full write-ups for every item in [wamp-checkup-round-2.md](wamp-checkup-round-2.md), the checklist that tracks what is done. Evidence line numbers are from commit `2d540764`. Re-check the current code before acting.

Each item lists the plain-language summary, the technical detail, the evidence the reviewer cited, and what the independent fact-checkers found. Where they disagree, **the fact-check correction overrides the original detail**.

### F251: Every room entry fetches the global leaderboard for an unused HUD summary; goal 'status' text is also never shown

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: game client)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** medium · **effort:** small
- **Related round-1 item:** F070

**Summary.** When a player enters or selects a published room with a goal, the game asks the server for the global top-5 leaderboard alongside the room leaderboard. The game never shows the global result: it only feeds an old HUD summary that is no longer drawn anywhere, plus a debug dump. The same dead HUD code is why every goal type must define a 'status' line, a countdown and a score format that players never see, and a test makes them mandatory. Removing it cuts one uncached server request per room entry and about 165 lines. Adding a new goal type also gets easier.

**Technical detail.**

Wasted request: OverworldGoalRunController.refreshLeaderboardsForRoom runs Promise.all of loadRoomLeaderboard(...) and loadGlobalLeaderboard(5) (src/scenes/overworld/goalRuns.ts:585-594). It runs on every room transition (roomTransition.ts:251-256), on world refresh, and on selection changes (windowController.ts:329, :452). loadGlobalLeaderboard sends `cache: 'no-store'`, and for 20 s after any run submission it also adds `fresh=1` (runRepository.ts:232-240, 264-267). On the Worker, fresh and signed-in viewers take the full or private-viewer path (src/cloudflare/worker/runs/routes.ts:782-796). The result lands in `this.globalLeaderboard`. Its only readers are getGlobalLeaderboard() (goalRuns.ts:180-182, no callers), getLeaderboardSummaryText() (628-661, no callers) and the debug snapshot (768-774). The live HUD reads only getCurrentRoomLeaderboard() (hudState.ts:311-313).

Dead chain to delete:
- goalRuns.ts: getGlobalLeaderboard/getLeaderboardState/getLeaderboardMessage (180-190), getGoalStatusText (619-626), getLeaderboardSummaryText (628-661), getGoalSubmissionStatusText (1174-1176, returns ''), the globalLeaderboard field, fetch and debug copy. About 72 lines.
- goalLifecycleRules.ts: the `countdown`, `status` and `scoreAsDuration` members of GoalLifecycleRule (14-16), limitedCountdown (30-31), the 7 per-goal implementations (~30 lines, including the 10-line survival and 8-line npc_quest status builders), formatGoalRunStatus and formatGoalRoomLeaderboardMetric (107-114). About 48 of 114 lines. These were moved out of a dead switch into the registry in b167c9c5 (2026-10-15, F070 work), so the dead text became a required part of the goal-type contract. goalRuns.lifecycle.test.ts:26-30 then makes it mandatory ('Presentation cannot be omitted').
- presence.ts: PresenceSummaryInput (110-114), getRoomPopulationsById/getRoomEditorsById (302-308) and getPresenceSummaryText (638-673). About 48 lines.

Because these are class methods and object-literal functions, rollup cannot tree-shake them. Strings such as 'Room top ', 'presence live' and 'goal race' ship in the boot chunk main-*.js (boot JS is 660.7 of 670 KB brotli).

Fix: drop the global call from the Promise.all, delete the chain, and repoint the lifecycle type test at a live member such as raceResolution or countsCheckpoints. Keep the debug snapshot's room leaderboard. Effort is about 1 hour.

**Evidence.**

- src/scenes/overworld/goalRuns.ts:585-594 — Promise.all loads room leaderboard and loadGlobalLeaderboard(5)
- src/scenes/overworld/goalRuns.ts:180-190 — getGlobalLeaderboard/getLeaderboardState/getLeaderboardMessage, no callers in src or scripts
- src/scenes/overworld/goalRuns.ts:619-661 — getGoalStatusText and getLeaderboardSummaryText, no callers
- src/scenes/overworld/goalRuns.ts:1174-1176 — getGoalSubmissionStatusText returns ''
- src/runs/runRepository.ts:232-240 — global leaderboard fetched with cache:'no-store' and fresh=1 inside the bypass window
- src/scenes/overworld/roomTransition.ts:251-256 — refreshLeaderboardForSelection on every room transition
- src/scenes/overworld/hudState.ts:311-313 — HUD reads only the room leaderboard
- src/scenes/overworld/goalLifecycleRules.ts:14-16 — countdown/status/scoreAsDuration required on every goal rule
- src/scenes/overworld/goalLifecycleRules.ts:107-114 — formatGoalRunStatus/formatGoalRoomLeaderboardMetric only reached from the dead getters
- src/scenes/overworld/goalRuns.lifecycle.test.ts:26-30 — test forces every goal to implement the unused status text
- src/scenes/overworld/presence.ts:638-673 — getPresenceSummaryText has no callers

**Fact-checks (3 independent reviewers).**

- **partially confirmed.** The dead chain and the wasted fetch are real and every evidence line holds. Three corrections:
  (a) The extra request skips the cache only on the client (no-store, no memory cache). On the Worker, anonymous requests hit a 20 s public edge cache and signed-in viewers pay auth plus a per-viewer D1 lookup. Only fresh=1 within 20 s of a submission does the full rebuild.
  (b) Add this benefit: Promise.all couples the two requests, so a failed or slow global request currently blanks or delays the room leaderboard the HUD does show (goalRuns.ts:604-614).
  (c) Repoint the lifecycle type test at a goal-typed live member such as destinationCompleted or startCompletion. raceResolution takes the run, not the goal.
  Bundle saving is about 1-2 KB minified; impact is medium.
- **confirmed.** No correction.
- **partially confirmed.** The request is browser-uncached (`no-store`), but it is not uncached on the server.
  - Anonymous viewers hit a 20 s edge cache (routes.ts:782-796), so they cost a Worker invocation and rarely a D1 read.
  - Signed-in viewers pay an auth lookup plus a D1 viewer-rank COUNT query on every call (globalLeaderboardViewer.ts:32-48), or a full rebuild under `fresh=1`.
  - The call also fires on browse selection changes (selection.ts:62) and again after a ranked run starts (goalRuns.ts:840), so signed-in ranked entries can send it twice.
  
  Impact is medium, not high: there is no visible effect, and the saving is about one Worker request per goal-room entry or selection. Deleting the lifecycle presentation members changes nothing visible; the live HUD and modal already format protect quests as pts. The presence.ts deletion is separate dead code, unrelated to the request.

**2026-10-22 delivered.** PR #291. [Receipt](wamp-round2-security-and-step1-2026-10-22.md).

### F252: PartyKit leftovers: a 141 MB dev dependency kept only for types, a local presence server unlike production, stale docs

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: Worker, scripts, configs and docs)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** medium · **effort:** small
- **Related round-1 item:** F197

**Summary.** Multiplayer now runs on Cloudflare itself, but the repo still installs the whole PartyKit toolkit (141 MB, including 2024 copies of Cloudflare's local runtime) only to borrow a few type names. `npm run dev:presence` still starts the old PartyKit server locally, so local testing doesn't match production. The README and setup docs still tell people (and AI agents) that presence runs on PartyKit. Replace the types with a small local file, delete the PartyKit configs and scripts, and update four docs.

**Technical detail.**

Usage: the partykit devDependency (package.json:176) appears only in `import type * as Party from 'partykit/server'`, in 5 files: partykit/presenceServer.ts:2, src/partykit/presenceInterest.ts:1, presencePopulation.ts:1, presenceServer.testHarness.ts:2 and src/cloudflare/presence/durableObject.ts:1. Size: node_modules/partykit is 141 MB, 132 MB of it in its own nested node_modules: 37 packages including miniflare 3.20240718.0, workerd 1.20240718.0, esbuild 0.21.5, undici 5.29.0 and @cloudflare/workers-types 4.20240718.0, beside the repo's current miniflare 4.20260730. quality.yml runs `npm ci` in 15 jobs per push, so every CI run unpacks that runtime 15 times. Its 2024 esbuild/workerd pins also add to the audit noise tracked in F197. Behaviour drift: package.json:26 `dev:presence` is `partykit dev`, which runs presenceServer.ts under PartyKit's own runtime, not the DO adapter production uses. `wrangler dev` already serves /parties/* (worker.ts: `if (url.pathname.startsWith('/parties/')) return handleCloudflarePresence(...)`). Stale defaults: scripts/presence_load_test.mjs:10 uses DEFAULT_HOST '127.0.0.1:1999' (the PartyKit dev port). scripts/remote_rollout_check.mjs:8-10 and :20-22 default to and block only the old partykit.dev host. Stale docs: README.md:11 ('PartyKit for realtime presence'), README.md:23-28 (run `npm run dev:presence`), README.md:39, docs/development/architecture.md:3 and :29-30 ('PartyKit validates the shared signing secret'), docs/development/environment.md:9, 28-30, 52-55 and 91. Fix: (1) Add src/partykit/presenceTypes.ts, about 40 lines, declaring the Connection/Room/Request/Lobby surface that durableObject.ts:13 says is all the core uses, and switch the 5 imports. (2) Remove the partykit devDependency, partykit.json, partykit.safety.json, dev:presence and presence:deploy:safety. src/config/executableEntryContract.test.ts:60 discovers partykit*.json, so the deletion keeps that test consistent. (3) Document `PARTYKIT_HOST=127.0.0.1:8787` in .dev.vars for local presence through wrangler dev. (4) Point presence_load_test at 8787. Keep `partysocket`: the client still uses it to connect to /parties/main/*.

**Evidence.**

- package.json:176 — "partykit": "^0.0.115" devDependency
- package.json:26 — "dev:presence": "partykit dev"
- src/cloudflare/presence/durableObject.ts:1 — `import type * as Party from 'partykit/server'`; line 13 says only a small socket surface is used
- partykit/presenceServer.ts:2 — type-only import of partykit/server
- README.md:11 — '- PartyKit for realtime presence'
- docs/development/architecture.md:30 — 'The Worker issues presence identity tokens, and PartyKit validates the shared signing secret.'
- docs/development/environment.md:52 — PARTYKIT_HOST="127.0.0.1:1999"
- scripts/presence_load_test.mjs:10 — DEFAULT_HOST = '127.0.0.1:1999'

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** The core claim holds: partykit is used for types only, `dev:presence` runs a different runtime from production, and the docs are stale. Widen the fix in three ways.
  
  1. Fix scripts/deploy_safety_branch.mjs. It still bundles VITE_PARTYKIT_HOST pointing at the partykit.dev safety host (lines 8-10 and 44-45; the bundled value overrides the runtime one) and runs `presence:deploy:safety` (line 95). PartyKit managed deploys ended Oct 16 and hosting ends Oct 23, so that step already fails and safety previews lose presence on Oct 23. Drop both the override and the step, and let the safety Worker's own PARTYKIT_HOST apply (wrangler.jsonc:92).
  2. Update every other place still tied to port 1999, partykit.dev or partykit.json:
     - the DEV fallback in src/presence/worldPresence.ts:959;
     - the WebSocket intercepts in smoke_progression_rating_modal.mjs:31 and smoke_wampos_window.mjs:15;
     - knip.json:38. Remove the partykit/presenceServer.ts entry, because executableEntryContract.test.ts:156-163 compares knip entries exactly.
  3. Update seven docs, not four. Besides README, architecture.md and environment.md, fix mobile-testing.md, safety-backend-foundation.md and frontend-redeploy-and-minting.md, which point at partykit.dev hosts that are shutting down.
  
  The local types file also needs Server, ServerOptions, Worker, ConnectionContext and the Room storage, context and env surface. That is about 60-80 lines, not 40.
  
  CI cost is extraction only: the npm cache is on, and Linux installs only Linux binaries.

### F253: The old editor toolbars and old phone tabs are still in every page load, always hidden, since the new dock replaced them

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: game client)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** medium · **effort:** medium
- **Related round-1 item:** F161
- **Also covers:** The old phone editor tab bar and its zoom/status panel are dead code since the phone dock shipped

**Summary.** The new editor dock has been switched on for every builder on every device since early October. The old sidebar toolbar, a second 'top tools' bar, about a dozen duplicate tool-option popups, an old phone status panel and the old phone tab bar were left in the page. They are always hidden, but every visitor still downloads them, the browser still builds them, and the code keeps them updated. Deleting them removes about 350 lines of page markup, about 280 lines of styling and about 160 lines of code. One side effect needs a decision first: the only 'Clear Layer' buttons live in these hidden panels, so builders have had no way to reach that action since the dock arrived.

**Technical detail.**

Why it is dead: isEditorDockShellActive() returns `doc.body.dataset.appMode === 'editor'` (src/ui/setup/editorDockShell.ts:187-189). Commit 9bff84ed (2026-10-04, the F161 fix) removed the `deviceClass !== 'phone'` exclusion. EditorPhoneDock is active whenever appMode is editor and deviceClass is phone (src/ui/setup/editorPhoneDock.ts:61). #sidebar only shows in editor mode (world/mode-visibility.css:4-5), and course-composer hides it (course-editor.css:25). So in every state where the sidebar is visible, the dock shell is active, and the dock CSS hides: every #sidebar .sidebar-section except #editor-actions (dock-shell.css:799-802, with no re-show rule for #tools-section); `#editor-actions .editor-top-tools-rail`, `.editor-tool-popover` and `> .mobile-editor-actions-panel` (dock-shell.css:967-974). #tools-section is also display:none on desktop (sidebar-layout.css:50-52) and on phone (phone-editor-dock.css:255-258). The old phone nav is hidden whenever the phone dock is active (src/ui/mobile/controller.ts:477-481).

What goes away:
(1) index.html markup: #tools-section 270-427 (158 lines, 10.0 KB); .editor-top-tools-rail 943-966 (1.4 KB); the #editor-top-* popovers 1175-1304 (9.0 KB); .mobile-editor-actions-panel 1305-1327 (1.4 KB); #mobile-editor-nav 2227-2246 (1.6 KB). Move #btn-mobile-editor-toggle into #editor-shell-phone-bar, because the phone dock re-parents it anyway (editorPhoneDock.ts:96). Total: 355 lines, 23.5 KB raw (~9% of dist/index.html), 240 of 2,598 elements.
(2) CSS: 55 whole rules and 279 lines whose every selector needs a retired state. That is 90 lines of `[data-app-mode='editor']:not([data-editor-dock-shell='true'])` rules plus the old phone nav, mobile status panel, old sidebar and top-rail rules, across phone-editor-tools/actions/shell.css, palette-goals.css, retro-skin.css, sidebar-layout.css, tools.css, world/bars-buttons.css and world/mobile-controls.css. Another 14 selectors in shared rules also go. Much of this ships in main.css to every player: dist main-*.css carries 19 `mobile-editor-nav` and 13 `mobile-editor-sheet` selectors.
(3) TS (~160 lines): in src/ui/mobile/controller.ts, EditorSheetId, activeEditorSheet/editorSheetCollapsed, handleAutoCollapse (113-127, which always returns early), bindMobileEditorNav (156-179), bindMobileEditorActions (181-193), syncEditorPaletteMode (196-206) and the render branches at 442-451 and 477-493. In uiBridge.ts, the 'More tools' popover state (318, 656, 675-700, 1880, 2025-2035), which adds a document click listener for toggles that can never be clicked, plus the mobile zoom bindings (1473-1478). Also the mobile ids in uiBridge/elements.ts:231-259 and interaction.ts:165.

Stale smokes to fix in the same change: smoke_room_camera.mjs:50 and :148 click a [data-mobile-editor-sheet] tab that is never visible. smoke_smart_autotiling.mjs:819-820 and :1312 click #btn-editor-top-tool-more inside a display:none rail. mobile_smoke.mjs:1144 and smoke_editor_dock.mjs:1049 only assert that the 'legacy editor nav' stays hidden.

Lost feature: `.editor-clear-layer-btn` exists only at index.html:373 and 1252, inside the hidden panels. The dock eraser picker (index.html:1404-1427) offers Nuke Terrain and Nuke Objects only. Either add Clear Layer to #editor-shell-eraser-size-picker before deleting, or drop clearLayerButtons (uiBridge.ts:819). The runEditorCommands 'clearCurrentLayer' op stays.

Also the always-true check at uiBridge.ts:1902 can go. Fix order: add Clear Layer to the shell, delete the markup, run the CSS deletion through check_style_cascade, delete the TS, then update the 3 smokes.

**Evidence.**

- src/ui/setup/editorDockShell.ts:187-189 — isEditorDockShellActive returns appMode === 'editor' only
- src/ui/setup/editorPhoneDock.ts:61 — phone dock active whenever appMode is editor and deviceClass is phone
- src/ui/mobile/controller.ts:477-481 — #mobile-editor-nav hidden unless phone editor AND phone dock inactive (never both)
- src/ui/mobile/controller.ts:113-116 — handleAutoCollapse returns immediately when editorPhoneDock is 'true'
- src/styles/sections/editor/dock-shell.css:799-802 — all sidebar sections except #editor-actions display:none under the dock shell
- src/styles/sections/editor/dock-shell.css:967-974 — top-tools rail, every .editor-tool-popover and the mobile actions panel display:none
- src/styles/sections/editor/sidebar-layout.css:50-52 — #tools-section display:none on desktop
- src/styles/sections/responsive/phone-editor-dock.css:255-258 — #tools-section display:none !important on phone
- index.html:373-376 and 1252-1255 — the only Clear Layer buttons, both in hidden panels
- index.html:1404-1427 — dock eraser picker has Nuke Terrain/Objects but no Clear Layer
- scripts/smoke_smart_autotiling.mjs:819-820 — clicks #btn-editor-top-tool-more inside the hidden rail
- scripts/smoke_room_camera.mjs:50 — clicks a [data-mobile-editor-sheet] tab that is never visible
- scripts/mobile_smoke.mjs:1144 — asserts the 'legacy editor nav' stays hidden
- src/ui/setup/editorDockShell.ts:187-189 — dock shell active for every editor session
- src/ui/setup/editorPhoneDock.ts:60-68 — phone dock active whenever appMode is editor on a phone
- src/ui/mobile/controller.ts:477-480 — legacy nav shown only when the phone dock is NOT active

**Fact-checks (3 independent reviewers).**

- **confirmed.** No correction.
- **partially confirmed.** The old sidebar tools, the top-tools rail, the #editor-top-* popovers, the mobile status panel and #mobile-editor-nav really are unreachable on every device, and Clear Layer has no UI. But removing them is mainly a maintainability and test-health cleanup plus a Clear Layer decision, not a speed win. Players save about 2.8 KB gzipped of HTML and a few KB of CSS, and the runtime cost is negligible.
  
  Corrections to the plan:
  - Smokes to update also include smoke_editor_dock.mjs:452 (reads #editor-top-erase-brush-select), smoke_editor_dock.mjs:1062, smoke_editor_phone_dock.mjs:69 and mobile_smoke.mjs:1173. smoke_room_camera (touch) and smoke_smart_autotiling are probably already timing out.
  - Keep these, which are still live:
    - the body data-mobile-editor-collapsed attribute (phone dock and phone-world-chat.css)
    - EDITOR_AUTO_COLLAPSE_EVENT (phone dock and paletteController)
    - the #btn-mobile-editor-toggle selectors in music.css and sprite.css
  - Delete the popovers through line 1303, not 1304. Line 1304 closes .editor-top-tools, which holds the live feature panels.
  - Remove the 'tools-section' line in sidebarSections.ts:366.
  - Decide on Clear Layer first: either add it to #editor-shell-eraser-size-picker or drop clearLayerButtons.
- **confirmed.** No correction.

### F262: The hidden 'Camera Tuner' developer panel ships to every player and measures the page on every menu change

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Mobile play on phones and tablets)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small

**Summary.** A developer tool for tuning the phone camera is built into every player's copy of the game: about 390 lines across 8 files. It only appears with a special web address, but part of it runs all the time. Every time any menu or chat opens or closes, it measures the screen layout. The camera values were tuned long ago and are now constants, so the tool can be removed or kept for development builds only.

**Technical detail.**

The tuner is enabled only by URL flags: cameraTuner, mobileCameraTuner, cameraDebug, mobileCameraZoom or mobileCameraTargetY (OverworldPlayScene.ts:3020-3058; controller.ts:551-563).

Shipped code, about 390 lines across 8 files:
- OverworldPlayScene.ts: about 208 lines. Public set/adjust/reset/log at 2967-3018, init/install/remove of window.wampMobileCameraTuner at 3020-3080, normalize/parse/storage helpers at 3218-3311 including localStorage key wamp_mobile_portrait_camera_tuning_v2.
- controller.ts: about 75 lines (bindMobileCameraTuner 314-353, URL check 551-563, value sync 565-581).
- phone-portrait-play-controls.css: about 58 lines (303-360).
- index.html: 12 lines of markup (2127-2138).
- Types in sceneBridge.ts, sceneCapabilityRegistry.ts and vite-env.d.ts.

Cost even when hidden: MobileUiController.render calls syncMobileCameraTunerValue unconditionally (controller.ts:508). That builds a snapshot calling controls.getBoundingClientRect() (OverworldPlayScene.ts:3202), which forces a synchronous layout. render runs on every class change of 36 .history-modal elements, chat, the auth panel and the busy overlay, plus app-mode and device-layout changes.

Keep: the constants and the framing code that normal play uses (shouldApplyMobilePortraitCameraTuning, getMobilePortraitRoomFramingCenterY, getMobilePortraitUnobstructedHeight), and the snapshot in debug state if wanted.

Remove: the URL tuner, the global API, the storage and the on-screen panel. At minimum, return early in syncMobileCameraTunerValue when the tuner is hidden.

scripts/mobile_smoke.mjs has a tuner scenario (13 references) that would be dropped or switched to the remaining debug state. If the 'whole room / zoom' player idea is built, reuse only the clamp helper.

**Evidence.**

- src/scenes/OverworldPlayScene.ts:3020-3058 — tuner enabled only by URL flags
- src/scenes/OverworldPlayScene.ts:3060-3080 — installs window.wampMobileCameraTuner
- src/scenes/OverworldPlayScene.ts:3267-3311 — tuner localStorage read/persist/clear
- src/scenes/OverworldPlayScene.ts:3202 — snapshot calls getBoundingClientRect
- src/ui/mobile/controller.ts:508 — value sync runs on every render, even when hidden
- src/ui/mobile/controller.ts:551-581 — URL check and snapshot formatting
- src/styles/sections/responsive/phone-portrait-play-controls.css:303-360 — tuner styles
- index.html:2127-2138 — tuner markup shipped to all players

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** This is not dead code. It is developer tooling turned on by URL flags, and the CI mobile-smoke job runs it as the 'phone-portrait-camera-tuner' scenario (scripts/mobile_smoke.mjs:96-99), so deleting it drops CI coverage. Better: return early in syncMobileCameraTunerValue when the tuner is hidden (one line, no downside). Optionally, gate the tuner API, markup, CSS and storage behind a dev or test build (VITE_ENABLE_TEST_RESET is already set in the CI smoke build) so the scenario keeps working. The speed cost is minor. The getBoundingClientRect read happens once per UI-state change, not per frame, and mostly moves layout work earlier rather than adding it. Keep the zoom and targetY fields and constants (used by short-screen framing) and the snapshot in describeState, which the smoke test asserts.

### F256: About 425 lines of Worker code nothing calls, led by the whole retired difficulty-vote system

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: Worker, scripts, configs and docs)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small

**Summary.** Fifteen Worker functions are never called by anything: not the API, the scripts or the tests. The biggest group is the old 'vote on difficulty' system, about 180 lines. It was replaced by star ratings in the progression update, and its only database write is itself dead. Removing them shrinks one of the files on the oversized-file list by about 10%, and they will stop confusing anyone reading the code.

**Technical detail.**

Method: knip lists these as unused exports. For each one, `rg -w <name>` over src/, scripts/ and partykit/ finds no use outside its own declaration, apart from the dead difficulty chain calling itself, and no test references any of them. Difficulty-vote chain in src/cloudflare/worker/runs/difficulty.ts: loadRoomDifficultyCounts (154-161), loadViewerRoomDifficultyVote (163-173), hasViewerRatedRoomVersion (175-203), buildRoomDifficultySummary (205-236), upsertRoomDifficultyVote (238-266), loadLatestDifficultyVotesByUser (1607-1637), dedupeLatestDifficultyVotesByUser (1640-1660) and summarizeDifficultyVotes (1663-1674). That is 181 lines, plus the RoomDifficultyVoteRow type at core/types.ts:535. The only INSERT INTO room_difficulty_votes in the codebase is difficulty.ts:249, inside the dead upsert. Other dead functions: runs/routes.ts:852 loadCompletedRoomRuns and :896 loadCompletedRoomRunsForVersions (93 lines); auth/store.ts:567 loadAllUserStatsRows (29); worldTiles/store.ts:406 loadWorldRenderTileLeafChanges (32) plus :1194 isWorldRenderTileCurrent and :1198 isWorldRenderLeaf; worldTiles/service.ts:380 worldTileAddressFromOutbox (8); worlds/access.ts:191 requireWorldForMutation (17; its play-only check is duplicated live in worlds/memberships.ts:135 and roomMutationIntegration.ts:41); rooms/guardrails.ts:59 enforcePublishLimitForUser (10; the real limit lives in progression/trustCaps.ts:209); expandedRooms/editorRoutes.ts:426 and expandedRooms/store.ts:960 (8). In src/mapScreenshot: infoOverlay.ts:84 buildFontFaceCss (17) plus the CORNER_MARK_* constants, and bounds.ts:68 worldPixelsPerContentPixel. Fix: delete them, remove the re-exports at difficulty.ts:61-71 that only fed the dead chain, and lower the eslint max-lines pin for difficulty.ts (eslint.config.js:17, 1762) by about 180. Then turn on knip's unused-export check for src/cloudflare/** only, gated in CI, so new dead Worker exports fail the build. The client keeps report-only mode.

**Evidence.**

- src/cloudflare/worker/runs/difficulty.ts:205 — export async function buildRoomDifficultySummary(...); no caller anywhere
- src/cloudflare/worker/runs/difficulty.ts:249 — the only `INSERT INTO room_difficulty_votes` in the codebase, inside the dead upsertRoomDifficultyVote
- src/cloudflare/worker/runs/routes.ts:852 — export async function loadCompletedRoomRuns; never referenced
- src/cloudflare/worker/rooms/guardrails.ts:59 — enforcePublishLimitForUser duplicates the live check at progression/trustCaps.ts:209
- src/cloudflare/worker/worlds/access.ts:191 — requireWorldForMutation; never referenced
- src/cloudflare/worker/worldTiles/store.ts:1194 — isWorldRenderTileCurrent / isWorldRenderLeaf; never referenced
- eslint.config.js:17 — 'src/cloudflare/worker/runs/difficulty.ts': 1762 pinned oversized

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** About 21 Worker and map-capture symbols are dead, roughly 400 lines.
  
  To delete them safely:
  - Also remove the two source-string expects at difficulty.contract.test.ts:174-177. They pin the dead INSERT and ON CONFLICT.
  - Keep the re-export block at difficulty.ts:61-71, because routes.ts, requestBodies.ts and the tests use it. ### F264: Three D1 tables are dead weight: two frozen since their features retired, one written on every publish and never read

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: Worker, scripts, configs and docs)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small

**Summary.** The old difficulty-vote table stopped being written when star ratings replaced it, and the Play.fun points table stopped when Play.fun was removed. Both are still copied, counted and cleared by admin tools. A third table records how much each room version changed, on every publish, yet nothing has ever read it. Either show that 'percent changed' figure in room version history, or stop writing it, and drop the two frozen tables in a later migration.

**Technical detail.**

room_difficulty_votes (migrations/0011): migrations/0019_progression.sql:180-207 copied all rows into room_ratings. Since then the only writer is the dead upsertRoomDifficultyVote (difficulty.ts:238-266) and the only reader is the dead chain (difficulty.ts:1607-1637). It is still touched by the admin room clear (admin/routes.ts:328), the safety snapshot (admin/snapshot.ts:38) and the test reset. playfun_point_sync (migrations/0008): no writer since 68588174 (2026-07-07). It is only counted or deleted in maintenance/routes.ts:32,49 and admin/snapshot.ts:35 via LEGACY_GENERATED_POINT_SYNC_TABLE. room_version_attribution (0019_progression.sql:165-178): progression/awards.ts:104-123 runs INSERT OR REPLACE on every publish, so 1 extra D1 write per publish, with contributor_weight_breakdown always `[{userId, weight: 1}]`. `git log -S 'FROM room_version_attribution'` finds no reader in the repo's history. Schema-wide check: only 10 of 1,213 migration-defined columns are never named in code, 7 of them in these legacy tables. Fix: (1) Remove the room_difficulty_votes references from admin/routes.ts:328, snapshot.ts and the reset. (2) Decide on room_version_attribution: percent_change is already computed (awards.ts:101) and could label versions such as 'v4 · 38% changed' in the version list. Otherwise delete the insert. (3) After a read-only production row count, follow docs/expanded-room-convergence.md:16 and drop the frozen tables in a separate destructive migration.

**Evidence.**

- migrations/0019_progression.sql:180-207 — INSERT … INTO room_ratings SELECT … FROM room_difficulty_votes (one-time copy)
- src/cloudflare/worker/runs/difficulty.ts:249 — only INSERT into room_difficulty_votes, inside dead code
- src/cloudflare/worker/admin/routes.ts:328 — still DELETEs from room_difficulty_votes on room clear
- src/cloudflare/worker/maintenance/routes.ts:49 — only remaining statement touching playfun_point_sync (DELETE)
- src/cloudflare/worker/progression/awards.ts:104-123 — INSERT OR REPLACE INTO room_version_attribution on every publish; no SELECT exists

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** Confirmed: all three tables are dead weight. room_difficulty_votes has no live reader or writer. Its whole read and write chain in difficulty.ts (lines 154-266 plus the helpers near 1607-1690) is unreachable, because buildRoomDifficultySummary and upsertRoomDifficultyVote have no callers. playfun_point_sync has had no writer since 68588174. room_version_attribution is written on every publish and never read.
  
  Corrections:
  (a) room_version_attribution is not only unread but redundant. room_version_facts.change_from_previous (migration 0064, F026) already stores the same per-version change and is what the rating window uses. The PRD defines percent_change as hidden on purpose. The recommended fix is to delete the insert in awards.ts:104-123 and the unused RoomVersionAttributionRow type (core/types.ts:667). If a "% changed" label is ever wanted, it should read room_version_facts, and it is a product decision.
  (b) Step (1) must also update the following:
    - scripts/refresh_safety_from_prod.mjs: IMPORT_ORDER and TABLE_BATCH_SIZES at :66, :70, :89 and :93, plus a skip entry for these tables.
    - The difficulty.contract.test.ts:174 assertion, which pins the dead INSERT.
    - roomClear.test.ts.
  The refresh script copies every prod table, and snapshot import returns 400 for tables outside SNAPSHOT_TABLES. So removing these tables from SNAPSHOT_TABLES while prod still holds rows breaks the safety refresh unless the script skips them, or the removal waits for the DROP migration.
  (c) The admin-clear DELETE at admin/routes.ts:328 is redundant because of ON DELETE CASCADE in 0011, so removing it is safe.
  (d) The drop would be the repo's first DROP TABLE migration.

### F265: Unused admin endpoints: a second world-tile admin API on the renderer Worker and a 364-line report nobody calls

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: Worker, scripts, configs and docs)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small

**Summary.** The map-tile renderer Worker has its own private admin API (status, repair, cleanup), separate from the main API's, and no script or page calls it. That means one more server holding the admin password for nothing. A 364-line 'expanded rooms migration report' added in May has never been called by any admin page or script. And the launch dashboard fetches live-player counts by going out to the public internet and back into its own server instead of asking it directly.

**Technical detail.**

Renderer: src/cloudflare/worldTileRenderer/worker.ts:59-80 serves GET /api/admin/status, POST /api/admin/repair and POST /api/admin/gc, with its own assertAdminAuthorized (619-631) and production GC confirmation (634-650). Every operator path goes to the API Worker instead: scripts/world_tiles.mjs:112,124,142,159 and deploy_prod.mjs:66-69 call /api/admin/world-tiles/{status,backfill,repair,activate,garbage-collect} (worldTiles/routes.ts:136-148). Nothing calls the renderer's endpoints, and repair already runs from its cron (worker.ts:151). Delete lines 59-80 plus loadRendererStatus (468-497) and the two assert helpers, keep /api/health, and unset ADMIN_API_KEY on the renderer. About 75 lines. Migration report: admin/routes.ts:97-99 serves /api/admin/expanded-rooms/migration-report via expandedRooms/migrationReport.ts (364 lines, added efd6beef 2026-05-26). It has no caller in launch-admin, the scripts or the docs. Either add a button in launch-admin's infrastructure tab, which would serve the convergence gate in docs/expanded-room-convergence.md:9, or delete it. Self-fetch: admin/launchStats.ts:1307-1322 builds `https://${PARTYKIT_HOST}/parties/main/__launch-stats__/stats` (api.wamp.land in production) and fetches it with the internal token. The Worker already has env.PRESENCE_ROOMS (cloudflare/presence/durableObject.ts:61 shows the direct `.get(idFromName(...)).fetch`). Calling the DO directly drops a public round-trip and the token check.

**Evidence.**

- src/cloudflare/worldTileRenderer/worker.ts:59-80 — renderer exposes /api/admin/status, /repair, /gc
- scripts/world_tiles.mjs:142 — operator tooling uses the API Worker's /api/admin/world-tiles/${action} instead
- src/cloudflare/worker/admin/routes.ts:97-99 — /api/admin/expanded-rooms/migration-report; no caller in src, html, scripts or docs
- src/cloudflare/worker/admin/launchStats.ts:1307-1322 — builds a public URL to the presence metrics room
- src/cloudflare/presence/durableObject.ts:61 — direct env.PRESENCE_ROOMS.get(...).fetch path already exists

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** Keep the first part only: delete the renderer's uncalled admin routes (worker.ts:59-80), loadRendererStatus, assertAdminAuthorized and assertProductionGarbageCollectionConfirmed. Also delete the now-orphaned worldTileRenderer/gc.ts (89 lines) and listReferencedR2Keys (store.ts:512). That is about 170 lines, not 75. First copy the renderer GC's caps on scanned and deleted objects into the API Worker's unbounded handleWorldTileGarbageCollect. Then unset ADMIN_API_KEY on the renderer, if it was ever set (not verified). Do not delete the expanded-rooms migration report. It is a manual diagnostic for the expanded-room migration, which is still under way (expanded-rooms-impact-audit.md:149,468). A launch-admin button is optional. The launch-stats self-fetch is admin-only and harmless. A direct Durable Object call would still need the internal token (presenceServer.ts:232), and PARTYKIT_HOST must stay for the client config. Treat that part as optional polish at most.

### F261: Remove dead render code: an unused NFT 'warm all art' function and the API share page nothing links to

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Gap review: Room-to-image renderers: several separate implementations drawing the same room)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small
- **Related round-1 item:** F041

**Summary.** Two functions in the NFT drawing code have never been called since they were added in March. One of them would download every art file in the game (over 400) if anyone ever did call it. The API server also still serves a share web page and redirect that no link points to: all shares use wamp.land/r/x/y. That page is where an open-redirect hole was found and patched earlier. Deleting about 80 lines removes that risk for good.

**Technical detail.**

Dead code:

About 80 lines removed.

- src/mint/roomMetadataRender.ts:86-92 — renderWampMintedRoomToPngDataUrl has no callers (grep)
- src/mint/roomMetadataRender.ts:488-503 — warmRoomMetadataRenderAssetCache has no callers (grep)

Replace the share route's 'page' target with a 301 to the wamp.land /r/x/y URL, which keeps resolveRequestedPublicUrl for /meta. Update routes.metadata.test.ts:103-109 and the 'page redirects visitors' comment and test description.

### F263: The old Mac LaunchAgent avatar queue (961 lines) was replaced by a Cloudflare container in April but never removed

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: Worker, scripts, configs and docs)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small

**Summary.** CryptoPunk avatars used to be built by a background job on your Mac. On April 28 a Cloudflare container took over, and the plan written then was to uninstall the Mac job once the cloud one had proven itself. The Mac job's three scripts and five npm commands are still in the repo. If the job is still installed, it checks the production database every minute and competes with the cloud runner. Check your Mac, uninstall it, and delete the scripts.

**Technical detail.**

Two complete queue runners exist. Cloud: src/cloudflare/cryptopunk-avatar-queue-worker.ts (611 lines), with a cron every minute in wrangler.cryptopunk-avatar-queue.jsonc and the container in cloudflare/cryptopunk-avatar-queue/, added in 3d5b5a56 (2026-04-28). Local: scripts/process_cryptopunk_avatar_queue.mjs (621), run_cryptopunk_avatar_queue_once.mjs (111) and install_cryptopunk_avatar_queue_launchd.mjs (229), added in 0c7b7fab the same day. The ledger row changed in 3d5b5a56 (`git show 3d5b5a56 -- feature-ledger.md`) calls the LaunchAgent 'a fallback' and says to 'uninstall local launchd fallback with npm run avatar:cryptopunk:queue:uninstall-launchd' once the Cloudflare queue marks a production Punk ready. The installer registers 'land.wamp.cryptopunk-avatar-queue' (install…launchd.mjs:8) with StartInterval 60 s by default (:31-33, :148). The processor defaults to remote: true (process_cryptopunk_avatar_queue.mjs:62) and runs `wrangler d1 execute --remote` on production at lines 192, 225, 359 and 393. Fix: run `launchctl list | grep land.wamp` on your Mac and uninstall if present (only you can check). Then delete the three scripts (961 lines) and package.json:98-102 (avatar:cryptopunk:queue, :once, :install-launchd, :uninstall-launchd, :safety), and their knip.json entries.

**Evidence.**

- scripts/install_cryptopunk_avatar_queue_launchd.mjs:8 — label 'land.wamp.cryptopunk-avatar-queue'
- scripts/install_cryptopunk_avatar_queue_launchd.mjs:31-33 — default interval 60 seconds
- scripts/process_cryptopunk_avatar_queue.mjs:62 — remote: true by default; wrangler D1 calls at :192, :225
- package.json:98-102 — five avatar:cryptopunk:queue* scripts for the local runner
- src/cloudflare/cryptopunk-avatar-queue-worker.ts:46 — scheduled() cloud runner that superseded it

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** Downgrade to low-impact repo cleanup. The LaunchAgent is not installed on this Mac: no land.wamp plist in ~/Library/LaunchAgents, nothing in launchctl list, no queue logs. Even when it ran, the atomic claim UPDATE meant it could only duplicate wrangler polling, never build a job twice. So nothing is competing and the Mac step is already done; drop the 'check your Mac' manual step.
  
  The cleanup itself is still worth doing:
  - Delete scripts/install_cryptopunk_avatar_queue_launchd.mjs and scripts/run_cryptopunk_avatar_queue_once.mjs (340 lines). These are clearly obsolete.
  - Delete scripts/process_cryptopunk_avatar_queue.mjs (621 lines) as well, unless Jonathan wants a manual fallback for draining the queue when the container is down. It repeats the Worker's claim/recover/mark-ready SQL, and it needs the same art inputs on the Mac as the container prep does.
  - Remove the five package.json scripts at :98-102 and the knip.json entries at :56, :67 and :71.
  - Remove the local-runner-only CRYPTOPUNK_AVATAR_R2_BUCKET line at docs/development/environment.md:81. The other CRYPTOPUNK_AVATAR_* vars are still used by the Worker.

### F255: About 40% of the Cyber autotile profile (341 lines) is an older resolver that only its own tests still use

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: game client)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small

Nothing in the game calls it any more, but about 290 lines of tests keep checking it, so it looks alive. ### F260: Music engine leftovers from the stems era and the sequencer rewrite: about 260 lines nothing calls

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Dead code: game client)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small
- **Also covers:** About 150 lines of unused audio code, plus a 'footstep' sound that is preloaded first but never played

**Summary.** The room music system has been rebuilt twice: stems, then the sequencer, then Arrange. Helpers from earlier versions remain: key transposition and relative-key math, stems lane and clip lookups, stems clip preview playback, note-name helpers, phrase type checks and tileset-coloured instrument palettes. Nothing in the game uses them. Music is still being actively worked on (open items F222, F228, F232–F234), so clearing these out makes the real engine easier to find and safer to change.

**Technical detail.**

Never referenced from production (rg plus transitive pass):
- src/music/key.ts:57-102: transposeRoomMusicKeyTonic, getRoomMusicKeyDeltaSemitones, getRelativeRoomMusicKey and getRoomMusicKeyLabel (46 lines). The tonal/@tonaljs imports stay for Note.pitchClass and the scale lookups.
- catalog.ts:74-99: getRoomMusicClipsForLane, isRoomMusicClipIdValidForLane, getDefaultRoomMusicPack and getAllRoomMusicLaneIds.
- pattern.ts: ROOM_PATTERN_TEMPO_STEP (24), SWING_STEP (28), MARGIN_COLUMNS (35), getPatternMidiNote (830-846) and getPatternStepNote (874-893).
- library.ts: MusicPhraseBatchRecord (30-42) and isMusicPhraseRecordTonal/Drum (279-289).
- model.ts:235-262: createEmptyRoomMusicLaneAssignments, createEmptyRoomMusicArrangement and createDefaultRoomMusic. createDefaultRoomMusic builds a 'stemArrangement' that no editor path can create any more; 4 test files use it as a fixture, so move it into a test fixture.
- patternKit.ts:312-314 and phraseArrangement.ts:42-45.
- config/tilesets.ts: TilesetMusicColorRole (39), getTilesetMusicInstrumentColor/Css/RgbCss (1347-1376) and getTilesetLocalTileIndex (1393-1400).

Class members, which do ship in bundles because rollup keeps class methods:
- RoomMusicController.previewClip (src/music/controller.ts:307-345, 39 lines; only controller.transitions.test.ts calls it). It plays a stems pack clip, and stems clip picking no longer exists. Library audition (F231) uses phraseAudition.ts instead.
- EditorMusicPatternController.getKeyTonic/getKeyMode/getActiveCellCount (musicPatternEditor.ts:264-270, 285-293).
- EditorMusicWorkflowCoordinator.isSequencerModeActive (musicWorkflow.ts:141-143).

Total about 260 lines. Keep the playback path for existing stems rooms (getLegacyStemNoticeVisible and 'Replace With Sequencer'), since saved rooms still hold that format.

**Evidence.**

- src/music/key.ts:57-95 — transposeRoomMusicKeyTonic / getRoomMusicKeyDeltaSemitones / getRelativeRoomMusicKey, no callers
- src/music/catalog.ts:74-99 — stems lane/clip helpers, no callers
- src/music/model.ts:255-262 — createDefaultRoomMusic builds kind 'stemArrangement', used only by tests
- src/music/library.ts:279-289 — isMusicPhraseRecordTonal/Drum, no callers
- src/music/controller.ts:307-345 — previewClip, called only from controller.transitions.test.ts
- src/config/tilesets.ts:1347-1376 — tileset music instrument colours, no callers
- src/music/controller.ts:307-345 — previewClip, called only from tests
- src/music/catalog.ts:74-99 — four helpers with no callers
- src/music/key.ts:57-95 — three helpers with no callers
- src/music/library.ts:279-289 — two predicates with no callers
- src/audio/sfx.ts:487-493 — setMuted/isMuted never called
- src/audio/engine.ts:184-187 — peekMusicBus never called
- src/audio/sfx.ts:88 — 'footstep' in the hot preload list
- src/audio/sfx.ts:277-281 — footstep cue config; no playSfx('footstep') in src
- src/music/model.ts:200-208 — both branches return DEFAULT_ROOM_MUSIC_BAR_COUNT

**Fact-check.**

- **partially confirmed.** Every symbol listed does lack production callers (about 268 lines in all), but the cost of keeping them is mostly readability.
  
  - **Bundle size:** Rollup already removes the module-level exports from the bundle. Only about 58 lines of class methods ship: previewClip, getKeyTonic, getKeyMode, getActiveCellCount and isSequencerModeActive. Impact is low, not medium.
  - **Key helpers and F228:** keep getRoomMusicKeyDeltaSemitones and getRelativeRoomMusicKey, or decide on purpose to drop them. F228's fact-check calls for a semitone-shift helper and relative-key handling for 'Match neighbors', and these are those pieces.

  - **Footstep cue:** remove 'footstep' from HOT_GAMEPLAY_CUES and FEEDBACK_CUES, and from SFX_CUES as well if footsteps won't be wired up. Otherwise background warming still fetches it. The saving is one small (about 8.5 KB) file.

### F258: About 85 lines of unused streaming methods and leftovers can be deleted

**Summary.** Several methods on the streaming controller have no callers anywhere in the game, including clearDraftRoom, getLoadedRoomBounds and two single-room course override methods. Others exist only as aliases, and the presenter split left six gaps of blank lines. Removing them shrinks the code every reader and agent has to understand. - src/scenes/overworld/coursePlayback.ts:156 — only setTransientRoomOverrides (plural) is called

Either keep setDraftRoom or rework that test, so it should not be lumped in as trivially dead.

The real map loader ended up using different code (the tile scheduler), and these helpers were never connected. About 200 lines of game code and about 200 lines of tests now describe behaviour that does not exist in the game, which can mislead anyone debugging the world map.

Never referenced outside their own tests (rg over src and scripts):

### F254: About 220 lines of CSS can never apply: removed HUD and menu classes, plus the pre-dock editor layout

- **Area:** Dead code (reviewer: Superfluous and duplicated code: UI, styles and pages)
- **Type:** cleanup · **impact:** low · **effort:** small
- **Also covers:** 155 lines of styling for 25 class names that no page or code uses any more (old world HUD title, auth header, profile stats rows)

**Summary.** Some style rules target things that no longer exist: old header and title pieces, a removed footer settings button, old profile stats rows. Others target an editor layout that can't appear any more, because the new dock layout now always switches on in the editor. Deleting them removes about 220 lines with no visible change.

**Technical detail.**

Method: a scan of all 2,395 class/ID names in the 88 CSS files against every token in TS, JS and HTML under src/ and the 15 HTML pages. Each name below has zero non-CSS references (rg). base.css:869-959 (.auth-header, .auth-copy, .auth-menu-action-row, .auth-title, .auth-identity-clickable; 21 lines). hud-goals.css:116-145 and :239 (.world-hud-topline/-title-wrap/-title/-beta/-label; 43 lines). phone-world-chat.css:56-61 and :297-305 (10). profile-sign.css:84-101 (.profile-stats-row/label/value; 19). controls-about.css:114 and :340-346 (.about-modal-note, .course-room-row; 12). object-inspector.css:39, :272, :326, :539 (.selection-info, #object-tooltip, .palette-hint-accent, #music-summary; 10). room-comments.css:53-60 (.world-footer-settings; 8). music.css:13 (.editor-music-key-grid; 5). Also sidebar-layout.css:219 .editor-advanced-primary-action and shared-modal-skin.css:358 #explore-summary. Total 26 rules / 128 lines. Separately, 19 rules / 90 lines require `[data-app-mode='editor']:not([data-editor-dock-shell='true'])`: palette-goals.css (15 lines), retro-skin.css:282-296 (18), phone-editor-shell.css (45), phone-editor-actions.css:28/46 (6) and phone-editor-tools.css (6). They can't match, because isEditorDockShellActive() is `appMode === 'editor'` (editorDockShell.ts:187-189) and syncActivation (:521-534) sets data-editor-dock-shell from a MutationObserver on data-app-mode (:428-435), which runs before paint. The same holds for the always-true second clause at scenes/editor/uiBridge.ts:1902. Fix: delete them, and add the scan as scripts/check_dead_selectors.mjs (allowing `prefix-${x}` dynamic classes, which the scan already detects) so this doesn't regrow.

**Evidence.**

- src/styles/sections/world/hud-goals.css:116 — .world-hud-topline (and -title-wrap :123, -title :130, -beta :140, -label :239): no markup or TS creates these
- src/styles/sections/base.css:869 — .auth-header (also .auth-copy :881, .auth-menu-action-row :894, .auth-title :946): unused
- src/styles/sections/modals/profile-sign.css:84-101 — .profile-stats-row/label/value: unused

- src/ui/setup/editorDockShell.ts:521-534 — syncActivation sets data-editor-dock-shell on entering the editor

- src/styles/sections/modals/profile-sign.css:84-104 — profile-stats-row/label/value with no markup

**Fact-check.**

- **confirmed.** Small scope fixes only. Several targets are one entry in a selector list (phone-world-chat.css:56, controls-about.css:114, sidebar-layout.css:219, shared-modal-skin.css:358, and base.css:870 where `.auth-row` must stay), so delete only the dead selector line, not the rule.
